gloss: first shrine visit of the year

definitions.gloss: first shrine/temple visit of the new year
definitions.explanation: The traditional practice of visiting a Shinto shrine or Buddhist temple for the first time in the new year.

examples.english: To go for the first shrine visit of the year.

examples.japanese: {初詣|はつもうで}で{今年|ことし}の{願|ねが}い{事|ごと}をした。
examples.english: I made a wish for this year at the new year shrine visit.

examples.japanese: {明治神宮|めいじじんぐう}の{初詣|はつもうで}は{混雑|こんざつ}する。
examples.english: Meiji Shrine gets crowded during hatsumode.

notes:
CULTURAL:
A major New Year custom in Japan. Many people visit shrines at midnight on New Year's Eve or within the first three days of January. Popular activities include drawing omikuji (fortune slips) and buying omamori (charms).
